requirements: Confirm your game version matches the one the mod requires
Confirm your mod loader (e.g. Forge / Fabric / NeoForge) matches the mod
An archive tool if the download ships as a compressed bundle
steps: Download the mod file completely (usually a .jar or an archive)
If it is an archive, unpack it first and check the layout
Locate the mods folder inside your game directory (create it if missing)
Move the mod file into mods, keeping the filename intact
Launch the game and verify the mod appears in the mod list
notes: The mods directory differs per loader; watch for version conflicts when installing several mods at once.
safety: Only fetch files from this site's download page, not third-party mirrors
Check the security scan status shown on the page before downloading
If the game crashes, remove the most recently installed mod first
